title: From 2 HP at 5-2 to first place: the whole game, state by state
notes: Annotated from the VOD on 2026-09-24 by reading paused frames in the owner's browser. HUD fields (gold, HP, level, XP, streak, shop, lobby) are read directly and carry confidence 1; boards list only the units with direct evidence (a shop purchase plus the trait panel) with confidence 0.2–0.35, benches are unknown, and the 2-1 augment pick was not visible (Expedition / Branching Out / Called Shot were offered; Rengar carries a Juggernaut Emblem from 3-5, consistent with Branching Out but unconfirmed). Most rounds have a start state (shop just rolled) and an end state (the board sent into combat). Keane drops to 2 HP at 5-2 with a 3-loss streak and then wins eight fights in a row on Rengar Rival with Juggernaut 6.
